listing.name: Arcanum Community Edition
listing.summary: Explore Arcanum Community Edition and follow the upstream project for requirements, downloads and setup.

steps.title: Set up a separate Arcanum copy
steps.instruction: Upstream describes a drop-in Community Edition runtime, but its GitHub release history currently has no published package. Keep an existing permitted build, or follow upstream’s source-build instructions. Use a separate copy of your own GOG/Steam Arcanum installation with the required DAT files and modules. On Windows, arcanum-ce.exe belongs in that game folder; choose it with that folder as the working directory. Linux uses the corresponding native arcanum-ce build. Portcove does not run innoextract or a game installer during discovery.

steps.title: Keep updates and data with your working copy
steps.instruction: Keep your original files and a separate working installation. You or upstream own runtime replacement, generated data, saves and settings; prepare updates in a separate folder and retain the current copy until ready. Portcove’s existing-installation review saves your selected launch details without running a helper. It does not back up, roll back or delete this external runtime.
